title: Audio Engine Evolution, Sound Management & Core Stability
label: Internal Alpha
summary: This update heavily refactors the audio processing pipeline, introduces real-time amplitude tracking for UI synchronization, and implements a custom-engineered dynamic gating system to solve hardware timing constraints.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Replaced the static audio listener with a manual byte-chunk reading loop for live amplitude tracking.
Utilized audioop.rms to calculate and emit live microphone volume levels (amplitude_changed) for real-time GUI animation.
Engineered a 100% human-designed Dynamic Gate Thresholding system to bypass hardware initialization spikes and delayed OS-level beep interference.
Implemented dynamic gate logic: initializes with a 5.0-second pause_threshold, then snaps to 1.5 seconds after exactly 3.0 seconds.
Refactored play_ting.py into a robust sound_manager.py supporting both custom and default system sounds.
Deployed the upgraded Listening widget into the center panel and connected the audio amplitude signal to centerboard.listening via visar_synapse.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Enabled highly responsive, real-time GUI voice animations synchronized with actual user audio input.
Applied rendering and logic refinements to centerboard.speaking.py.
Improved global codebase hygiene by cleaning up minor variable naming and scope issues across multiple files.

sections.title: Fixes & Security
items: Resolved critical QEventLoop and 'QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running' crashing errors.
Implemented safe memory lifecycle handling using Qt's deleteLater() to ensure background audio workers terminate cleanly without crashing the main thread.
Resolved legacy play_ting import issues across the news boxes.

sections.title: Removed & Deprecated
items: Removed the legacy static, blocking audio listener pipeline in favor of the new byte-chunk reading loop.

notes: A critical highlight of this release is the Dynamic Gate Threshold—a complex hardware-software timing solution that was 100% theorized and implemented manually without AI assistance. This release dramatically stabilizes the threading architecture, completely eliminating QThread destruction crashes.
